::: {#def-causal-model .theorem}
## Causal model

A causal model $\mathcal C$ of "observational" NPSEM $\mathcal M$ under intervention $\Gamma$ is an NPSEM that is generated by combining $\mathcal M$ with its interventional NPSEM $\mathcal M^{(\Gamma)}$ and constraining the error term for each random variable in the interventional NPSEM equations so that it is equal to the error term for the  same variable in the observational NPSEM.

$$
\mathcal{C} = \mathcal{M} \cup \mathcal M^{(\Gamma)} 
$$


$$
\text{for all } V \in \mathbf V, \quad {U_V} = {U}^{(\Gamma)}_V
$$




:::
